# ChatSum

You open a chat after a couple of days of silence, and there are already a thousand new messages.
One command, and instead of an endless feed you get a neat breakdown: everything sorted by topic, condensed to the essentials, with every conclusion backed by a quote.
You skim the headings and stop only at what matters.
Want more detail? Read short excerpts from participants' own words and follow a link straight to the spot in the chat where the debate happened.

Thousands of messages in a chat, one command, and you get a tidy breakdown: the main topics, who said what, important links and numbers. No need to scroll through a week of chat. The bot reads everything itself and sorts it into neat categories.

## What it can do

- **Summary for a period:** "what was in the chat over the last 12 hours / 2 days".
- **Summary by count:** "break down the last 50 messages".
- **Scheduled summary:** every morning you get a chat digest automatically, without commands.
- **Export without a neural network:** save the conversation as text to review manually.

## What the result looks like

Instead of a hundred messages, you get topics with conclusions. Click to expand a piece of a live summary ([full breakdown](https://telegra.ph/Sammari-chata-vajbkodery-10-04-4)):

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

Ornn8/bside-olivia-community.body:
# BSide Olivia Community

**Keep the letters, replies, and life continuity with 林离 on your computer.**

**[Download the latest version](https://github.com/Ornn8/bside-olivia-community/releases/latest)** · [Quick Start](#快速开始) · [Changelog](#更新记录) · [Documentation index](https://github.com/Ornn8/bside-olivia-community/blob/HEAD/client/docs/README.md) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/Ornn8/bside-olivia-community/issues)

BSide Olivia Community is an **unofficial** companion recreation project for Windows. It connects a local backend inside an isolated copy of the original client that you legitimately obtained. The experience of writing letters, waiting, and receiving replies stays unchanged. It adds long-term memory, 林离's daily world, QQ chat, voice, photos, and songs.

> [!NOTE]
> **Letters and memories stay on your machine; generation happens in the cloud.** Letters, long-term memory, world records, and received media are stored on your computer. Replies, semantic judgments, and voice, photos, songs, and videos are generated by Olivia's cloud. You only need an Olivia account Key. No dedicated GPU is required.

## What it can do

### Writing and replies

Write a letter and receive 林离's reply after a while. Replies can be text, or they can include her voice, a photo, or a song she sings for you, depending on the content of the letter and the reply methods you allow. Audio plays in the inbox, where you can see the waveform and drag the progress bar.

### Cover songs and song library

Provide an original song, confirm the lyrics, and send it off. 林离 will cover it in her own voice. You can also ask her to write an original song. Completed songs appear in your inbox and can be saved to the song library.

### QQ / WeChat chat

After binding, chat with 林离 on QQ. In everyday short chats she often replies with one or two short voice messages, and she sends photos or voice messages when you ask for them. She also reaches out on her own at suitable times, and respects it when you say “don't bother me these next couple of days.”

### 林离's world

The “World” page shows her plans for today, what she is doing, and her mood at the moment. Her life continues in real time: classes, meals, piano practice, sleep. Each day's schedule is different.

### Long-term memory

She remembers what you have talked about, how you address each other, and the agreements you have made. If you correct a statement, it is updated accordingly. Memories can be viewed, searched, and corrected in settings.

### Your data stays in your hands

Letters can be exported as a backup with one click, or imported from the original client directory or a backup file. Neither the repository nor the installer contains any private letters.

## Quick Start

Requires **Windows 10/11 x64**, a legitimately obtained original client **`0.0.9.627`**, and an **Olivia account Key**.

huangkiki/Dexlab.body:
# DexLab

**Using classical physics laws and established empirical formulas as references, this project studies how contact and friction affect robotic grasping through reproducible experiments, and assesses the credibility of physics simulation.**

We use inclined-plane friction, one-dimensional collision, and gripping experiments to check the forces, motion, and contacts in simulations against analytical solutions, conservation laws, and empirical relations with cited sources. This repository provides **experimental conclusions, reproducible code, and raw data**, analyzes which measurable factors affect grasping performance, and states the conditions under which the conclusions apply.

[English](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) · [Chinese docs site](https://huangkiki.github.io/Dexlab/zh-cn/latest/index.html) · [Experiment report](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/blob/HEAD/docs/site/zh/results.md) · [Installation and reproduction](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/blob/HEAD/docs/installation.zh-CN.md) · [Versions and data downloads](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/releases)

The docs site is updated automatically with each merge into main. The homepage provides experimental conclusions, same-condition comparisons, and coverage status for the six engines.

## Tasks currently supported

Choose a run entry point by task, then review the corresponding protocol, environment, and results. The table below records the scope **that DexLab has implemented and retained evidence for**. "Run" includes failures, and "passed" covers only the versions, configurations, and scenarios specified in the report.

| Task | Existing engines and verification status | Run and evidence entry |
|---|---|---|
| Inclined-plane friction, one-dimensional collision | MuJoCo/SuperDex have paired inclined-plane tests, including passes and failures; one-dimensional collision has MuJoCo records | [Inclined-plane comparison](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/blob/HEAD/docs/incline-comparison-results.zh-CN.md) · [Collision](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/blob/HEAD/docs/elastic-impact-results.zh-CN.md) |
| Planar sliding, normal loading/unloading, cylinder gripping | MuJoCo/SuperDex/PhysX have run development cases, retaining failure and geometry refinement results | [Contact experiments and commands](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/blob/HEAD/demos/contact-benchmark/README.zh-CN.md) |

Puts environment setup, model downloads, tagging, parameter configuration, training, and result viewing into one Windows desktop tool. Suited for training **character, art style, and concept LoRAs**, and also includes video and audio training modes.

| Advantage | What you can use directly |
|---|---|
| **Four engines, one workflow** | Choose the model and version first, then get a kohya, musubi, AI Toolkit, or Fizgig recommendation based on your GPU, with the reasoning shown |
| **AI assistant takes part in training directly** | State your goal; the assistant asks follow-up questions to fill in requirements, then calls environment checks, model downloads, project configuration, and training workflows |
| **Less hassle with environments and downloads** | Graphical install and repair, domestic (China) download mirrors, resumable downloads for large files; existing models can be selected |
| **Parameter changes are visible** | Six training presets; parameter changes are shown before applying, with undo and manual adjustment supported |
| **From data preparation to result comparison** | WD14, Chinese / English captions, tag editing, fixed-seed sampling, history viewing, and A/B comparison |
| **Concept slider LoRA** | Text guidance or image pairs for training; supports two-way changes, weakening or strengthening the effect, and direct viewing of a five-level weight comparison (experimental) |
| **Standalone prompt reverse-engineering** | Generates English keywords or Chinese-English descriptions for single or batch images, with editing, copying, and TXT export |
| **Orderly management of multiple projects** | Project configs, processed data, and outputs are managed separately, with training records, a task queue, and log export |

Six presets: **get the pipeline running first / quick effect test / lower VRAM usage / standard training / faster per-step speed / more training volume**.

# dsh-suite

> 🌐 Chinese · [English](https://github.com/whyihaveyou/dsh-suite/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

**Stop digging through the `dsh-plugin` topic. Everything here is a plugin that still works.**

`dsh-suite` is the **living directory** of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugins, **automatically refreshed every hour and compatibility-tested daily**. It also includes the DSH built-in **plugin store**, the `create-dsh-plugin` scaffolder, several in-house plugins, and an **[all-in-one workstation](https://github.com/whyihaveyou/dsh-workstation)** (🚧 under development).

**🧭 Ecosystem / Ecosystem**

- 🌐 [Directory website](https://whyihaveyou.github.io/dsh-suite/zh.html): browse all plugins online
- 📖 [DSH Chinese docs · dsh-docs.com](https://dsh-docs.com): Chinese tutorials and documentation, ready to use without a VPN
- 📕 [DSH Plugin Development Guide](https://github.com/whyihaveyou/dsh-plugin-tutorial): published as a book in Chinese and English
- 🎨 [Theme gallery](https://whyihaveyou.github.io/dsh-themes/): 151 themes with day and night previews

---

## Why dsh-suite

DSH launched without an official plugin registry. Finding plugins currently means digging through GitHub’s `dsh-plugin` topic (50+ scattered small plugins) and a few static awesome-lists that appear overnight. Meanwhile, DSH itself keeps shipping **breaking changes**.

So we did four things:

1. **A “living” directory**: 880+ curated plugins. CI refreshes the data **every hour**, and **every day** installs the indexed packages into a temporary profile to retest compatibility.
2. **A built-in plugin store**: `@dsh-suite/plugin-manager` adds a **Store** tab to the settings page of the DSH Web UI. Browse the directory, search, view badges, and install with one click, all without leaving DSH.
3. **A scaffolder**: `npm create dsh-plugin` generates a runnable `dsh.bundle` + Cordis skeleton in one command. DSH has no official scaffolder, and “how do I migrate my plugin” is one of the most-requested needs in the community.
4. **Several in-house plugins**: not just repackaged third-party code, but first-party output.

zyjhandsome/SayInk.body:
# SayInk — Speech-to-Text Desktop Tool

A local, offline **dictation input** tool: **hold a hotkey to speak, release to recognize and paste at the cursor** (default). Uses local ASR for recognition, with optional LLM polishing. It can also switch to **automatic continuous transcription** (hold to start listening to an entire session; output appears automatically after each pause), or capture **computer playback audio** or **mixed** sources to listen to meetings. With these two sources, results are **only recorded to history and not pasted**, so they will not be mistakenly typed into the current window.

The version number follows `__version__` in **`sayink/version.py`** (currently **2.2.3**). Installer filenames, Inno metadata, and the `SayInk.exe` properties on Windows are all kept in sync with it.

> **Formerly VoiceInk.** When upgrading from VoiceInk, installing SayInk first uninstalls the old VoiceInk and renames `~/.voiceink` (settings, history, downloaded models) as a whole to `~/.sayink`. API Keys in the credential manager are also migrated automatically. No reconfiguration or model re-download is needed.

**Documentation navigation**

| Reader | Suggested reading |
|------|----------|
| **End users** | [Feature overview](#功能一览) → [Quick start](#快速上手) → [FAQ](#常见问题) |
| **Developers / maintainers / Agents** | [Source structure](#源码结构) → [Building from source](#从源码打包) → [Change review checklist (required reading)](#变更审查清单必读) → [Design system](https://github.com/zyjhandsome/SayInk/blob/HEAD/design-system/MASTER.md) / [UX redesign](https://github.com/zyjhandsome/SayInk/blob/HEAD/docs/ux-redesign.md) / [OpenSpec archive](https://github.com/zyjhandsome/SayInk/blob/HEAD/openspec/changes/archive/) |

---

## Feature Overview

### Two Trigger Modes

| Mode | Description | Use cases |
|------|----------|----------|
| **Hold to speak** (default) | **Hold** to speak, **release** to recognize and paste. Press **Esc** while recording to cancel. After release, the dictation bar immediately switches to “recognizing.” If the previous utterance has not finished recognizing, holding the key again shows “please wait” and does not merge the two utterances. Pressing Esc at this point also will not drop the previous utterance. | Everyday dictation, short phrases, precise control |
| **Automatic continuous transcription** | **Hold the hotkey** to start listening to the whole session. After pauses, it automatically recognizes and outputs text. **Esc** or **End** on the dictation bar ends the whole session (segments in progress still complete). | Meetings, long dictation, continuous input |…
